content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IET Calicut University Instructor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Institute of Engineering & Technology Calicut University (IET Calicut University) for hiring qualified candidates in Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The available post under this recruitment notification is Instructor, offering temporary contractual engagement to eligible and experienced candidates meeting the criteria.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced by the Institute of Engineering & Technology Calicut University under advertisement number 15/IET-A-ASST-3/2025/Admn.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application and selection is Walk-in Interview. Interested candidates need to directly attend the interview venue on the specified date along with necessary documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Instructor position is officially scheduled to take place on 08-10-2026 at the designated reporting venue of the university.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Instructor post must possess a 3-year Diploma along with a minimum of 2 years of relevant professional experience in the required field.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit prescribed for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 59 years as on the date of notification. Candidates should ensure they meet this criteria before attending.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or remuneration offered for the Instructor post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a daily wage of ₹ 660/- per day, subject to a maximum upper ceiling limit of ₹ 16,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee prescribed for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories for attending this walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the detailed official notification?
faq.answer: You can read and download the complete official notification PDF by using the direct link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
